'''Darren Dunstan''' is an American-based Canadian voice actor and was also a voice director for the [[4Kids Entertainment]] English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with DDO Artists Agency.

==Biography==
Originally from Toronto, Canada, Dunstan is now based in New York. He has voiced characters in a number of anime series, including Pokémon, and has had acting roles on stage. He played {{an|Giovanni}} in [[Pokémon Live!]].

Dunstan joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} around the end of [[S05|Pokémon: Master Quest]], once [[4Kids Entertainment|4Kids]] moved the dubbing of the series from [[TAJ Productions]] to their own studio, where he took over as voice director for the series. He also was the voice director for the {{pkmn|movie}} ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]'' during this period. He remained in this role until {{TPCi}} obtained dubbing rights to the series. He has made small appearances as a voice actor since then, most notably as [[Stephan]].
